scenarios.scenario_abstract: With one hundred dollars available and computer use as the only stated purpose, [X] compares optional features for new glasses at normal monitor distance, against light and dark screen content and nearby reflections, while preserving enough budget for any needed prescription, fit, and core lens quality.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一百美元预算内、且唯一明确用途为电脑使用的情况下，[X]会在正常显示器距离、明暗屏幕内容和附近反光条件下比较新眼镜的可选镜片功能，同时为可能需要的处方、适配和核心镜片质量保留足够预算。
examples: using Anti-Glare when room or window reflections stop masking text without adding an unwanted cast
testing Photochromic only if the pair also moves between outdoor and indoor light rather than assuming screen use needs it
rejecting an optional label when it consumes the budget without improving the user's actual viewing task

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo week in Maui, [X] plans repeated snorkeling, shoreline time, historical stops, coastal driving, and resort breaks, comparing features for a well-fitting mask and separate sunglasses by fog during water transitions, reflected brightness, terrain readability, care, and the need to switch optical roles rather than force one item to do both.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自前往毛伊岛一周时，[X]会安排多次浮潜、岸边活动、历史景点、海岸驾驶和度假村休息，并根据水上水下切换时的起雾、反射亮度、地形可读性、护理需求以及是否应切换不同光学用品而非强迫一件装备兼顾两种用途，比较合身面镜和独立太阳镜的功能。
examples: using Anti-Fog when the mask remains readable through preparation, humid pauses, and repeated immersion
using Mirrored when surface sunglasses reduce harsh reflected brightness without hiding signs or terrain
keeping mask and sunglasses functions separate even when both appear on the same packing list

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an open-air R&B stadium concert, [X] considers sunglasses for the bright arrival, queues, ticket checks, and photographs, then plans to store them or change eyewear before navigating a dark parking lot and congested drive home, comparing features by how safely and quickly they adapt as daylight disappears.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 参加露天 R&B 体育场演唱会时，[X]会考虑在明亮的入场、排队、验票和拍照阶段佩戴太阳镜，并计划在穿过昏暗停车场和驾车汇入拥堵路段前将其收起或更换眼镜，再根据日光消失时能否及时、安全地适应来比较镜片功能。
examples: using Photochromic only when the lenses clear sufficiently before the performance and exit route darken
testing Night Vision as a low-light contrast direction without claiming that it guarantees safe driving
removing the daytime pair when it obscures people, lot markers, or the route

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a solo Iceland itinerary moving among snow and glacier viewpoints, waterfalls, roads, hot pools, city stops, and warm lodging, [X] plans sunglasses even outside summer and compares features by reflected brightness outdoors and whether visibility recovers after abrupt cold-to-warm transitions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自游览冰岛并在雪地和冰川观景点、瀑布、公路、温泉、城市与温暖住宿间移动时，[X]即使在非夏季也会准备太阳镜，并根据户外反射亮度和突然由冷转暖后视野能否恢复来比较镜片功能。
examples: using Mirrored when snow and glacier reflections are reduced without losing terrain detail
using Anti-Glare when water, ice, road, and signage remain distinguishable under broad reflected light
using Anti-Fog when entering a hot-pool facility or warm lodging no longer blocks the next task

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shifting among a dim classroom board, books, a phone, computer work, and bright outdoor PE, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, using that familiar pair to identify where a future lens feature would reduce pair changes, reflections, or indoor-to-outdoor interruption.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在昏暗教室的黑板、书本、手机、电脑学习和明亮的户外体育课之间切换时，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，并借这副熟悉的眼镜判断未来哪些镜片功能能减少换镜、反光或室内外中断。
examples: using Bifocal when board viewing and close reading remain usable without repeated pair changes
using Anti-Glare when classroom or computer reflections stop masking text while ordinary contrast remains intact
using Photochromic only when the correction remains clear indoors and changes appropriately for outdoor PE

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While following an organic seasonal spray plan for old peach and apple trees, [X] selects protective eyewear for mixing, overhead canopy application, moving branches, drifting droplets, and cleanup, checking lens integrity and visibility before each later round rather than treating the eyewear as a substitute for label compliance and coverage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为老桃树和苹果树执行有机季节喷洒计划时，[X]需要为药剂混合、仰头喷冠、移动枝条、飘散液滴和清理选择防护眼镜，并在之后每轮操作前检查镜片完整性和视野，而不把眼镜当作遵守标签与完整防护的替代品。
examples: using Impact Resistant when lenses must tolerate twig, nozzle, and incidental debris contact
rejecting ordinary eyewear that leaves the eyes exposed during overhead spraying
replacing damaged protective lenses before the next seasonal application

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To remove recurring mold from a bathroom ceiling, [X] chooses safety goggles for overhead spraying and wiping, then compares lens visibility as moisture accumulates and the exhaust fan clears the room, pausing whenever condensation, splashes, or falling debris make the ladder and exit hard to see.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 清除浴室天花板反复出现的霉斑时，[X]需要为仰头喷洒和擦拭选择安全护目镜，并在湿气积聚及排风扇排湿过程中比较镜片视野；一旦冷凝、飞溅或掉落碎屑使梯子和出口难以看清，就暂停作业。
examples: using Anti-Fog when the ceiling, spray path, ladder, and exit remain visible in humid air
using Impact Resistant when the lens also faces flakes, brush contact, and small overhead debris
stopping the task when vision fails instead of wiping inside the goggles while exposed

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a self-planned Namibia desert trip, [X] adds quad biking and dune hiking and expects the operator to provide a helmet and goggles, comparing suitable lens features against exposed sand, windblown grit, vibration, bright terrain, and quick looks between the trail and guide.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 自行规划纳米比亚沙漠旅行时，[X]增加了四轮摩托和沙丘徒步活动，并预计运营方提供头盔和护目镜，再根据裸露沙地、风沙、震动、明亮地形以及在路线和向导之间快速观察的需求来比较合适的镜片功能。
examples: using Impact Resistant when provider goggles must tolerate flying grit and incidental contact
using Mirrored when broad desert brightness is reduced while dune contours and guide signals remain visible
using Anti-Glare when reflected light no longer washes out ruts and sandy edges

scenarios.scenario_abstract: At a next-day Cartier optometrist visit in one-degree weather, [X] wears a wool coat and arrives in afternoon daylight to compare candidate lens features by the showroom window, outdoors, and after returning through the warm doorway, without assuming that the brand or frame determines lens performance.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一摄氏度天气中于次日下午去验光店试戴 Cartier 眼镜时，[X]会穿着羊毛大衣，并在展厅窗边、室外以及重新穿过温暖门厅后比较候选镜片功能，而不假设品牌或镜框本身决定镜片表现。
examples: using Photochromic when the lens responds outdoors yet returns to a clear indoor state before the next comparison
using Anti-Fog when the cold-to-warm doorway no longer interrupts inspection or movement through the shop
checking reflections and light response directly instead of treating luxury branding as evidence

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While assembling a first home-repair kit, [X] plans staged practice on drywall holes, trim, shelves, drilling, cutting, and scraping, selecting safety glasses whose lenses can be inspected for chips, scratches, and clear peripheral sight before each new tool or exercise is introduced.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 组建第一套家庭维修工具时，[X]会分阶段练习修补石膏板孔洞、处理饰条、安装搁板、钻孔、切割和刮削，并选择每次引入新工具或练习前都能检查是否有崩口、划痕及清晰周边视野的安全眼镜。
examples: using Impact Resistant when lenses must remain intact through drywall fragments, drill debris, and incidental tool contact
replacing a meaningfully damaged pair rather than continuing because part of the lens remains transparent
keeping side coverage, dust control, and task technique as independent safety checks
